title: 第7章 沧海遗珠第8章 慷慨者的奖励
content_zh:
叶霄尘凝视着蜷缩在地的少年，系统面板在眼前浮现：
【姓名：叶寒星】
【年龄：十岁】
【修为：无（未修炼）】
【天赋：叶家古脉·星辉体（未觉醒）】
【血脉详情：】
【起源：传承自叶家初代家主叶星辰，为千年难现的隐性血脉】
【特征：】
【1.
经脉如星河脉络，可容纳十倍于常人的玄气】
【2.
觉醒后双目会浮现星芒，夜间视物如白昼】
【3.
对星辰类功法有300%的领悟加成】
【觉醒条件：】
【1.
需在星光下引气入体】
【2.
服用星辉草或同源灵物】
【3.

遭遇生死危机时可能自行觉醒】
【当前状态：血脉沉寂（被阴煞之气压制）】
【悟性：75100（聪慧机敏）】
【气运：黑转黄（吉人自有天相）】
【忠诚度：40（因管事欺凌而恨叶家，但对宿主抱有期待）】
叶霄尘凝视着眼前的少年，心中掀起惊涛骇浪。
惊讶，然后欣喜！
他原以为叶寒星只是继承了叶家古老的血脉，却不想还身负更为罕见的特殊体质。
这世间的天赋，就像一群人在比身高。
普通修士不过是站在平地上，而那些拥有上等玄脉者，则如同站在台阶之上，自然更易触及修炼的奥秘。
但像叶寒星这样身负特殊体质之人，却像是生来就站在高塔之巅，俯瞰众生。
也就是说，要是叶寒星愿意和他“做朋友”
，这将是他最大的一个充电宝。
不过现在我们沧海遗珠同学的思想好像有些问题，看来要赶紧给他做做思想教育，提高一下他的家族认同感。
叶霄尘缓步走到两人跟前，玄色衣袍在尘土中纤尘不染。
他看也不看跪伏在地的管事，目光径直落在少年身上。
叶寒星。
他声音清冷如霜，你希望我救你吗？
这一声呼唤如同惊雷炸响。
跪在地上的管事猛地抬头，脸上横肉颤抖：尘少爷！

您认错人了！
content_en:
Ye Xiaochen stared at the young man curled up on the ground, and the system panel appeared in front of his eyes:
[Name: Ye Hanxing]
[Age: ten years old]
[Cultivation: None (not practiced)]
[Talent: Ancient Veins of the Ye Family·Star Body (Unawakened)]
[Bloodline details:]
[Origin: Inherited from Ye Xingchen, the first generation head of the Ye family, it is a hidden bloodline that is difficult to find in thousands of years]
【Features:】
【1.
The meridians are like the veins of a galaxy, and can hold ten times the amount of profound energy of an ordinary person]
【2.
After awakening, stars will appear in your eyes, and you can see things at night as if they were in daylight]
【3.
There is a 300% comprehension bonus for star-type exercises]
[Awakening conditions:]
【1.
Need to introduce gas into the body under starlight]
【2.
Take Xinghui grass or the same source of spiritual food】
【3.
May awaken on its own when encountering a life or death crisis]
[Current status: Bloodline is silent (suppressed by the evil spirit)]
[Comprehension: 75100 (intelligent and alert)]
[Luck: black turns to yellow (auspicious people have their own destiny)]
[Loyalty: 40 (hate the Ye family due to bullying by the boss, but have expectations for the host)]
Ye Xiaochen stared at the young man in front of him, and his heart was filled with turmoil.
Surprised, then delighted!
He originally thought that Ye Hanxing had just inherited the ancient bloodline of the Ye family, but he didn't want to end up with a rarer special physique.
Talents in this world are like a group of people competing for height.
Ordinary monks are just standing on the ground, but those with advanced profound veins are like standing on steps, and naturally it is easier to access the secrets of cultivation.
But people with special physiques like Ye Hanxing seem to be born to stand on the top of a tower, overlooking all living beings.
In other words, if Ye Hanxing is willing to "be friends" with him
, this will be his biggest power bank.
But now our classmate Canghai Yizhu seems to have some ideological problems. It seems that we need to give him ideological education as soon as possible to improve his sense of family identity.
Ye Xiaochen walked slowly to the two of them, his black robe unstained in the dust.
He didn't even look at the steward who was kneeling on the ground, and his eyes fell directly on the young man.
Ye Hanxing.
His voice was as cold as frost. Do you want me to save you?
This call was like thunder.
The steward who was kneeling on the ground suddenly raised his head, his face trembling: Master Chen!
You got the wrong person!
